I told Sofia in her #coastal-team thread that the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow Home Living, not Pellucid.

That comes from the Feb 17 thread in #coastal-team. Sofia said the Mid-Atlantic home goods "PHL" rows are Pellow and the Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid. Kwame then confirmed her retail account was the one with the lamp delivery at door 6, and that the container pickup was the other one.

My reply also said Kwame was right, which wasn't well founded. The thread doesn't show either of them disagreeing, so that line was a guess.
